section_a.question: What connects life stories from different centuries?
options: They must describe the same profession.
They can still speak to the same classroom.
They are all about collecting wealth.
They avoid difficult choices.
section_a.explanation: The opening establishes that stories from different centuries can still become meaningful classroom lessons.

section_a.question: What did the actress need when helping children was difficult?
options: A larger audience and a new film contract
A faster ship and a bigger fleet
A life without responsibility
Ambition and perseverance
section_a.explanation: The passage connects her ambition to help children with the perseverance required when comfort was easier.

section_a.question: What does the final image suggest about greatness?
options: Greatness can appear in different places and leave a legacy that inspires others.
Greatness belongs only to famous performers.
Greatness can be measured by the size of a fleet.
Greatness requires people to choose comfort first.
section_a.explanation: Both the explorer's voyages and the actress's service show that greatness can take different forms and inspire others.

section_b.question: What made Audrey Hepburn remarkable beyond her film career?
options: Her elegant style alone
Her magazine portraits
Her humanitarian work
Her decision to avoid public life
section_b.explanation: The passage emphasizes that humanitarian work defined her later decades beyond the screen.

section_b.question: How did compassion change the meaning of Hepburn's fame?
options: It turned fame into service.
It made her return to every film role.
It kept her away from children in need.
It reduced her mission to a magazine portrait.
section_b.explanation: Compassion redirected public attention toward service for hungry children.

section_b.question: What does her biography teach students to look for?
options: Only the most elegant public images
A career with no difficult choices
Devotion to others that can outlast the spotlight
A mission defined by fame alone
section_b.explanation: The closing sentence presents devotion to others as more lasting than celebrity attention.

section_c.question: What did Zheng He's voyages carry across the Indian Ocean?
options: Only military orders
Magazine portraits and film scripts
A plan to isolate every country
Goods, maps, and mutual respect
section_c.explanation: The passage describes exchange through goods, maps, and mutual respect.

section_c.question: How does the passage describe Zheng He's legacy?
options: As a story of conquest without exchange
As a narrative of peaceful contact across eras
As a private ambition with no modern meaning
As a warning against learning from history
section_c.explanation: The passage contrasts peaceful contact and shared responsibility with mere conquest.

section_a.title: Two Lives, One Lesson
section_a.passage: Life stories from different centuries can still speak to the same classroom. One story follows an explorer whose voyage across oceans built peaceful exchange. Another follows an actress whose ambition to help children demanded perseverance, even when comfort was easier. Their professions were different, yet both chose service over personal ease. Students who compare such stories learn that greatness is not a single template. It can appear in a fleet crossing distant seas or in years of service to children, leaving a legacy that inspires others.

section_b.title: Audrey Hepburn — a real angel in the world
section_b.passage: Audrey Hepburn remains a remarkable figure long after her film career. Fans admire her elegant style, but humanitarian work defined her later decades. She devoted years to charity programs for hungry children. Compassion turned fame into service, and her mission went far beyond the portrait on a magazine cover. Students who read her biography learn that devotion to others can outlast any spotlight.

section_c.title: Stories of China
section_c.passage: In the early fifteenth century, Zheng He commanded a fleet that crossed the Indian Ocean. Each voyage carried goods, maps, and mutual respect. The explorer's legacy is not mere conquest; it is a narrative of peaceful contact across eras. Chinese students today witness how one era's courage can inspire another classroom's discussion about responsibility and global trust.

questions.question: What do the two figures share?
options: The same profession
Difficult but meaningful choices
A dislike of travel
A focus only on wealth
questions.explanation: 两人都做出了艰难而有意义的选择。

listening.title: Listening: Life stories
listening.script: During a history seminar, our group compared two biographies. One followed an explorer whose voyage with a fleet opened routes for exchange; the other traced Audrey Hepburn's career, from an elegant public image to humanitarian work. Years after acting, she supported charity programs for children facing hunger. That mission demanded perseverance: compassion had to become continued action. At first we wanted to rank their influence by fame. Our instructor asked us to witness a different measure—what each person chose to do for others. Neither chose only the easier, private path; both devoted time to service. Their lives belonged to different eras, yet ambition guided action in each. A meaningful legacy can take many forms and still inspire people.

questions.question: What do the explorer and the actress have in common?
options: They became influential through similar careers in the same era.
They devoted their later lives to the same charitable cause.
Their different professions both involved choosing service over personal ease.
Their service mattered only because both had already become famous.
questions.explanation: 听力明确对照两种不同职业，并总结两人都选择服务而非个人安逸。相同点是价值取向，不是职业或时代相同。

questions.question: What did Audrey Hepburn devote years to after her film career?
options: Taking part in charity programs for children facing hunger.
Returning to acting to keep her public profile in the spotlight.
Organizing peaceful exchanges between distant communities.
Training young performers to take over her film career.
questions.explanation: 讲者说她在演艺生涯之后仍支持帮助饥饿儿童的慈善项目；这里考查的是时间顺序和她后来投入的工作。

questions.question: What conclusion about greatness does the listening support?
options: A lasting legacy depends on staying in one profession.
Public recognition is a more reliable measure than service.
Service becomes meaningful only when it reaches a large audience.
Different forms of service can leave an inspiring legacy.
questions.explanation: 结尾指出，两段人生经历的职业和时代不同，但都留下了服务他人的影响；因此，有启发性的遗产不只有一种形式。

sentences.zh: 请将下列句子译为英文：伟大探险家的人生与航行故事提醒我们，影响力来自行动而非名声本身。
sentences.en_reference: The life stories and voyages of great explorers remind us that influence comes from action, not fame itself.
